# Credits

Hitbox Fixer is written and maintained by [@Garey27](https://github.com/Garey27).

:::note

This is a third-party project, not a ReHLDS organization one. It is documented here because it is widely deployed alongside ReHLDS and because it is the actively maintained replacement for the organization's own deprecated [hitboxtracker](/docs/hitboxtracker). Support requests belong in its own issue tracker, not in the ReHLDS one.

:::

## Project links

- [Source repository](https://github.com/Garey27/hitbox_fixer)
- [Releases](https://github.com/Garey27/hitbox_fixer/releases)

## How to help

Run it on your server and report hit registration problems through the [issue tracker](https://github.com/Garey27/hitbox_fixer/issues), including your engine (ReHLDS version or HLDS build), the mod, and a demo or reproduction steps if you can. The author notes that support for additional mods can be requested there. Pull requests are also welcome.
